problem: Previous session backend was eventually consistent KV, not isolate-local memory. Logout deletion could be stale elsewhere, read/modify/write throttle could lose concurrent updates, credential changes had no generation invalidation.
change: Single named durable authority; serialized persisted state; no KV/positive auth cache fallback; monotonic credential generation; failures return 503 and failed logout never claims durable revocation.

coverage: Two independent ingress Worker services share one named SQLite-backed Durable Object
Process restart preserves sessions, logout revocation and login budget
Monotonic credential generation invalidates old sessions and rejects stale ingress/authority and downgrade
12 concurrent invalid logins: exactly 5 responses 401 and 7 responses 429
